# CooptaIQ

> CooptaIQ brings recruitment assessments, employee onboarding, people management and workplace learning together in one platform. Built for companies that want a more organised way to manage their people.

CooptaIQ is a pre-launch workforce platform based in Lagos, Nigeria.

## What CooptaIQ does

- Recruitment assessments: create assessments, share candidate links, review results.
- Employee onboarding and management: profiles, records and user management.
- Learning and training: courses, assignments and learning progress.
- Employee assessments and performance: assessment results and progress visibility.
- AI-assisted creation of assessments and learning materials.

Candidates complete recruitment assessments through shared links. They do not need an account or dashboard access.
